channel.title: Fire Engineering Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Fire Engineering Magazine (fireengineering.com)

item.title: Plow Truck Helps CT Firefighters Access Tractor-Trailer Fire During Storm
item.description: A commercial plow truck assisted firefighters in accessing a tractor-trailer fire during a snowstorm in Wethersfield.

item.title: From Gut to Grid: Leading the Data-Informed Fireground
item.description: The class equips fire officers to enhance leadership by using operational data in decision-making, focusing on practical applications of CAD, GIS, RMS, and AI tools for effective fireground management.

item.title: Types of Inward-Swinging Door Forcible Entry
item.description: Luke Gregory of Wood’s Forcible Entry reviews three methods of forcible entry on an inward-swinging door.

item.title: High-Rise Fire, House Explosion Underscore Benefits of Mutual Aid for IL Departments
item.description: A pair of weekend fires in East Alton highlighted the importance of mutual aid among local fire departments during emergencies.

item.title: Application Period Now Open for MSA’s Globe Gear Giveaway
item.description: The 2026 application period for MSA’s Globe Gear Giveaway is open, providing volunteer fire departments in need with turnout gear and helmets to enhance firefighter safety.

item.title: KY Crews Battle Fire at Road Department’s Maintenance Garage
item.description: Firefighters battled a fire for nearly seven hours at the Rockcastle County Road Department garage, using 67,000 gallons of water. One firefighter sustained minor injuries.

item.title: What 2022 Fire Study Says Wichita Needs
item.description: Wichita's fire department faces significant response-time gaps, with a 2022 report recommending new stations and staffing. The city has withheld the report, hindering accountability and action.

item.title: Firefighter Injured Battling Three-Alarm CT Fire During Blizzard
item.description: A firefighter was hospitalized after a three-alarm house fire in Avon during a blizzard. All occupants escaped, and the cause is under investigation by the Fire Marshal’s Office.

item.title: Wichita Fire Chief to Retire
item.description: Wichita Fire Chief Tammy Snow will retire by August. A national search for her replacement will begin soon.

item.title: Ousted LAFD Chief Accuses Mayor of Retaliation in Palisades Fire Whistleblower Lawsuit
item.description: Former LAFD Chief Kristin Crowley is suing Mayor Karen Bass, alleging retaliation to deflect blame for the Palisades fire, which resulted in 12 deaths and significant damage, amid scrutiny of city response.
